claims.quote: Tsc2, Nprl3, Stradα , or Kptn were knocked out (KO) using CRISPR/Cas9 in N2a cells in vitro .
All knockout lines formed multi-cell aggregates compared to control lines within 24-48 hours of plating in vitro .
Aggregation was abolished with mTOR inhibitor treatment, establishing the mTOR-dependency of aggregate formation.

claims.object_text: aggregation not driven by proliferation, apoptosis/necrosis, or extracellular DNA
claims.quote: Aggregation was not driven by cell proliferation, apoptosis/necrosis, or the presence of extracellular DNA in culture media.

claims.object_text: altered expression of adhesion, cytoskeletal, and protein processing/transport molecules
claims.quote: LC-MS/MS analysis revealed altered expression of protein across KO lines including adhesion molecules (e.g., contactin-3), cytoskeletal proteins (e.g., stathmin-2), and protein processing/transport (e.g., Uevld).
